title: GetPrivateLinkStatusRequest
description: Request object for retrieving the status of a Private Link.

subnetIds.description: List of subnets in the given cloud network to query Private Link status. This field has been deprecated.

vNetId.description: Virtual Network Id to query the status of Private Link in Azure.

vpcId.description: VPC ID to query the status of Private Link in AWS.

cloudServiceProvider.description: Cloud Service Provider. Supports AWS and AZURE.

CloudServiceProvider.description:
Supported cloud providers
 `AWS` - A value indicating AWS as supported cloud provider for creating Private Links. `AZURE` - A value indicating Azure as supported cloud provider for creating Private Links.
